title.zh: 碳中和与能源智联国际大科学计划（CNEST）
title.en: Carbon Neutrality and Energy System Transformation (CNEST)

aliases: Carbon Neutrality and Energy System Transformation

summary.zh: 清华大学牵头发起的国际大科学计划培育项目，联合高校、研究机构和能源企业，研究碳中和约束下能源系统如何规划、运行与转型。项目将全球碳流监测与能量、物质及信息流分析结合，利用大数据和人工智能优化能源生产、供应、储存与使用，并组织跨学科、跨国联合研究。
summary.en: CNEST is an international big-science cultivation programme initiated and led by Tsinghua University. It brings universities, research institutes and energy companies together to investigate energy-system planning, operation and transformation under carbon-neutrality constraints, combining global carbon-flow monitoring with energy, material and information flows and data-driven optimisation.

actors.zh: 清华大学牵头，清华大学碳中和研究院参与组织。启动报道列明北京大学、北京师范大学、华北电力大学、耶鲁大学、帝国理工学院、剑桥大学等参与方；官网成员页还列示新加坡国立大学、西门子、日立等科研与产业机构。此处国别标签对应这些有明确依据的机构所在地，不代表全部成员国。
actors.en: Tsinghua University leads the initiative, with organisational participation from its Institute for Carbon Neutrality. The launch report names Peking University, Beijing Normal University, North China Electric Power University, Yale, Imperial College London and Cambridge. The official membership page also lists NUS, Siemens and Hitachi. Country tags cover these documented institutional locations, not every member country.

mechanism.zh: 以共同科学问题组织六项研究任务：能源系统理论、全球碳流观测、能源网络、智能协同技术、低碳及零碳和负碳技术、数字孪生。高校和科研机构提供系统建模与监测研究，产业参与方带入工程问题和应用需求；年度国际论坛与专业期刊承担研究交流、议题讨论和成果传播。
mechanism.en: Six research tasks address system theory, global carbon-flow observation, energy networks, intelligent coordination, low-, zero- and negative-carbon technologies, and digital twins. Academic teams contribute modelling and monitoring research, while industry brings engineering questions and application needs. International forums and a specialist journal provide channels for research exchange and dissemination.

observed.zh: 2023年11月22日举行培育项目启动工作座谈会。2025年6月27日至29日在北京举办首届国际论坛，官方报道记载19个国家的400余位代表参会，并发布北京倡议及《碳中和科技评论（英文）》期刊。2026年4月3日公布的论坛征稿通知进一步列出能源转型评估、碳监测与核算、能源网络、人工智能与能源等议题。
observed.en: A cultivation-project launch meeting took place on 22 November 2023. The first international forum was held in Beijing on 27–29 June 2025, with more than 400 representatives from 19 countries according to the official report; it launched the Beijing Initiative and Technology Review for Carbon Neutrality. A forum call published on 3 April 2026 listed topics including transition assessment, carbon monitoring and accounting, energy networks, and AI and energy.

constraints.zh: 跨国能源系统研究的执行条件包括监测与模型口径可比、数据使用授权明确、工程验证场景可获得，以及学术研究和企业应用之间的任务分工。合作网络与论坛活动能够支撑交流，但技术效果仍需由具体项目的运行数据和独立验证证明。
constraints.en: Implementation depends on comparable monitoring and modelling methods, clear data-use permissions, access to engineering validation settings and agreed academic–industrial responsibilities. Collaboration and forums support exchange; technical performance requires project-level operating evidence and independent validation.

transfer.zh: 中国地方可围绕电力系统、工业园区或城市能源系统提出可验证的共同问题，将高校的建模与碳监测能力同企业的设备、工况和试验场景配对。政府支持宜落实到数据接口、联合研究任务和示范验证条件，并通过分阶段工程结果评估合作，而非只以签约或参会规模判断成效。
transfer.en: Chinese regions can define testable questions around power systems, industrial parks or urban energy systems and pair university modelling and carbon-monitoring capabilities with industrial equipment and operating settings. Public support can focus on data interfaces, joint tasks and validation facilities, with cooperation assessed through staged engineering results rather than agreement or attendance counts.
